## Unused variable, import, function or class Unused variable width. --- To fix this without changing behavior, keep the existing constants but actually use them.

In src/zen/little-window/ZenLittleWindow.sys.mjs, inside onClosed’s else block (around lines 99–101), replace the hardcoded resize call with the local variables already defined:

  • Keep const [width, height] = [1000, 600];
  • Change win.resizeTo(1000, 600); to win.resizeTo(width, height);

This removes the unused-variable warning while preserving exact runtime behavior.

## Unused variable, import, function or class Unused variable height. ---

Remove the unused variable declaration inside onClosed in src/zen/little-window/ZenLittleWindow.sys.mjs.

Best fix without changing functionality:

  • In the else branch of onClosed, delete const [width, height] = [1000, 600];.
  • Keep win.resizeTo(1000, 600); as-is (or alternatively use constants consistently, but the minimal safe change is deletion only).
  • No imports, methods, or additional definitions are needed.
